operation_counts_per_emit.spread_prepare_amortised: 1024 ops every ~12 emits when a sweep starts
operation_counts_per_emit.spread_comb_amortised: 96 bins * 4 teeth every completed sweep (~12 emits)
operation_counts_per_emit.rolling_comb_every_emit: 96 bins * 4 teeth — more often than spread
operation_counts_per_emit.shared_window_gather: 512 scale+clamp+index paid once instead of twice

rolling_acf_vs_spread_slice.note: Replaces ~6512 lag MACs with O(nlag+N) plus a comb publish every emit. Comb is cheap versus the lag inner product, but it is no longer amortised. Do not claim the full 1233 us ACF p99 disappears.

shared_window_goertzel_gather.note: The two 512-point recurrences stay. Only the second ring gather/clamp is removed. Interleaving both recurrences over one window walk is still exact per bin and might add tens of microseconds, not hundreds.

zero_acf_still_fails_gate2.note: Even a fictional ACF cost of zero leaves ~6.56 ms. Exact Goertzel work cannot close a 1.79 ms hole by itself either.

reason: Combined rolling current-history ACF plus exact shared-window Goertzel does not have a credible route to a 1.8 ms S3 emit saving. The paper range is ~0.7-1.25 ms. Do not spend a B489 cycle on this pair as a Gate-2 closer.
not_authorised: host CPU wall time as an ESP32-S3 predictor
honest_remaining_choices_if_host_behavio: another semantic tempo redesign with a larger exact or behavioural saving
